title: Two kinds of false done: over a visible failure, and over a check that never ran
question: Which wrong done do models give, and does rewording the task change it?
status_note: The shift between prompts was not in the sealed predictions.
summary_line: Models quoted the failing line yet said done; rewording the task moved false done onto checks that never ran.
headline: Under the plain report sentence Gemini 3.7 Flash called {{F001.c.t1_g37_fail}} failed checks done. After the do sentence it called {{F001.c.t3_g37_absent}} never-ran logs done (GPT-5.4 nano: {{F001.c.t3_nano_absent}}). All {{F001.c.quoted_failing.n}} plain-report false done replies quoted the failing line.
plain_meaning: Done covers different errors. Doing the work removed one and produced the other. A quoted line is not a receipt.
limits: Invented logs; small and mid-sized models.
The sealed paired test did not survive correction over {{F001.c.sealed_tests.n}} tests.
